observed: After the nightly supplier import or a promotion, checkout keeps charging the old price until the workers restart; an admin price change reaches one checkout worker but not the others.
reproduction: Warm two PriceCache workers over one ProductStore, then bulk_import / apply_discount / set_price on 'A': total() still returns the old price (tests/test_price_visibility.py, failing before the fix).
root_cause: Cache invalidation is left to each write path: bulk_import and apply_discount write the store without invalidating any cache, and set_price invalidates only the one cache it is handed, so every other worker's PriceCache keeps serving the stale price. Any new write path will repeat the mistake.
invariant: After any write to a product's price, through any path, every checkout worker charges the new price, while unchanged prices stay cached.
fix: Make the store the single place that announces writes: put/put_many notify subscribers, every PriceCache subscribes and drops the changed SKU, and callers no longer invalidate by hand.
